The '''Congress of Caliphs''' was the main governing body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] and the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] species. The congress was made up of hereditary rulers known as ''[[caliph]]s''. Most [[City/Legends|cities]] had one caliph, but others, such as [[Thousand Thousand]], the largest city on the planet, had several. The Congress of Caliphs took a cut of all [[Mining/Legends|mining]] profits on Makem Te.<ref name="Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
